scope: synthetic research only; no Source/, research plugin, Nov 2 v3 DI plan, target thresholds or defaults changed
candidate_scope: high path only; renderer-only suffixes; shifts restricted to -2,-1,0,+1,+2

confirmation.rule: freeze code and selection before confirmation; do not tune from confirmation results

gates: Unmodified Validation/transpose-latency-targets.json version 2. Any T1/T2/T4 failure or T3 ceiling breach rejects adoption.
tail_metrics: Original 15-60 ms / 0-15 ms HF peak ratio, input SNR >=10dB
Extended 15-120 ms (stop 5ms before next event), to detect displaced echoes
absolute output late/main ratio as well as excess over input; counts above +6dB are diagnostic, not an audibility gate
selection: Among candidates passing existing gates, prefer lower worst late/main HF ratio and fewer >6dB tail increases at every sample rate. If tradeoffs or regressions remain, keep all candidates research-only and report no safe replacement.
block_invariance: All 3 rates, +/-1/+/-2, 3 representative inputs, 13 fixed/random partitions; exact float equality
cpu: Thread CPU and wall time separately; alternate engines, 5 repetitions; 64/128 blocks, all 3 rates, +/-2; no hardware T5 PASS claim
high_frequency: Reproduce PR202 ideal-shift reference residual metric separately for v3 and v4; interpolation independent from tail policy
listening: NOT_RUN: no real DI supplied, no listening or DAW verdict
